dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive stability certificate for one iteration. Its constructor D024 requires nonnegative error parameters, backward-error bounds for the computed matrix and right-hand side, a perturbed least-squares property, columnwise perturbation bounds, three applications of the arbitrary small predicate, and a solution-reconstruction error bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is only the antecedent of the target's error-bound implication. The theorem does not establish this stability certificate; if it is uninhabited, the error-bound branch is vacuous.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first field of an iteration, namely its real dimensionFactor d_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies the final error coefficient. It is preloaded in the iteration and is constrained only by d_k >= 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-fifth field of an iteration, its computed solution vector xHat in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is compared with the system's exact solution in the relative forward error on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: A semantics record consisting, via D032, of arbitrary predicates small and secondOrder on real numbers, with only the law secondOrder(0).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The small predicate occurs inside the conditional stability certificate, while secondOrder classifies the final additive remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive local progression certificate for a family: iteration 1 satisfies the spectral condition, and whenever a next iteration with index k+1 fails it for 0 < k < n, the current iteration satisfies D080.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The assumed mgs object supplies the finite local laws from which a suitable index is selected; it contains no preselected index.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real n by n matrices, Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the system matrices and of every right preconditioner MR and claimed inverse MRinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: An appendix certificate for a family. Its constructor D037 stores right-preconditioner quantities and a conditional function producing an error-decomposition certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An appendix object is assumed universally. It supplies q for each selected index and inverse pair and supplies the conditional componentwise error analysis used for the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the first appendix field, rightQuantities(k,MR,MRinv,hMR).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines q after k and the right inverse pair are chosen; q may depend on the appendix, k, MR, MRinv, and the inverse proof.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: A right-preconditioner quantity certificate. By D038 it contains a spectrum certificate for MR Z_k and proofs that its minimum value, two relevant matrix norms, and two Frobenius condition products are strictly positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its spectrum supplies the denominator used by alpha and beta, while its positivity fields protect all denominators in the final coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of natural numbers k satisfying 0 < k and k <= n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existentially selected dimension is necessarily one of 1,...,n; zero is excluded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family containing a system, a nested basis family for that system, and an iteration object for every valid k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All exact, computed, spectral, and error data in the proposition come from this universally quantified family.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a family's second field, its basisFamily.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the basis matrix Z_k used in transformed matrices, coefficients, and reconstruction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a family's third field at k, namely iteration k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies d_k, error parameters, xHat, spectra, and all iteration-specific data used in both conjuncts.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a family's first field, its linear system.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies A, Ainv, ML, MLinv, b, and xExact.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a system's seventh field, the exact solution vector xExact.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference vector and denominator in the relative forward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For square matrices A and Ainv, the real number ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives both the right-preconditioner condition product and the transformed-system condition product. The definition itself does not require its arguments to be inverses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The relation Bound_semantics(lhs,rhs): there exists a real remainder r with secondOrder(r) and lhs <= rhs + |r|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the final conclusion. Its scalar remainder is a genuine existential witness inside the stability and right-preconditioner quantifiers.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The relative vector error ||xHat - x||_2 / ||x||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With x=xExact, it is the exact left-hand side of the asserted forward-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-sided inverse relation: Ainv(Ax)=x and A(Ainv x)=x for every vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The quantified MR and MRinv are considered only with a proof of this relation; the system also stores such proofs for A,Ainv and ML,MLinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The spectral condition 1/sigmaMin(VHat_k) <= 4/3 and sigmaMax(VHat_k) <= 4/3, using the stored spectrum certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first conjunct required of the selected iteration and is also a premise of the appendix's error-certificate function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square matrix MR (Ainv ML).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with D022 it forms the transformed inverse pair whose Frobenius condition product multiplies the final coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square matrix MLinv (A MRinv).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm occurs in alpha and beta, and it is one member of the transformed condition product in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: For q and iteration k, the exact coefficient alpha*epsilonC + beta*epsilonB + beta*ug + lambda*epsilonX, with alpha, beta, and lambda defined by D053-D055.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target multiplies this defined coefficient by d_k and the transformed condition product; it is a computation from stored data, not an assumed coefficient formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for D001. It assumes epsilonC, epsilonB, ug, epsilonX are nonnegative; ||deltaC||_F <= epsilonC||MLinv A Z_k||_F; ||deltaB||_2 <= epsilonB||MLinv b||_2; yHat globally minimizes the residual for computedC+leastSquaresDeltaC and computedB+leastSquaresDeltaB; every column of [leastSquaresDeltaB,leastSquaresDeltaC] has norm at most d_k ug times the corresponding column norm of [computedB,computedC]; small(ug||computedC||_F/sigmaMin(computedC)); small((epsilonC+epsilonB+ug)||MLinv A Z_k||_F/sigmaMin(exactC)); ||deltaX||_2 <= epsilonX||Z_k yHat||_2; and small(epsilonX).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are bundled constructor assumptions behind the implication antecedent. None is independently derived by the target declaration.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The iteration-data bundle for a system, semantics, basis family, and valid index k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It preloads all numerical method data and structural equations used by the proposition; the target does not construct an iteration.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the fourth iteration field, epsilonB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the relative right-hand-side perturbation parameter in the stability certificate and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the third iteration field, epsilonC.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the matrix perturbation and contributes alpha*epsilonC to the coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the sixth iteration field, epsilonX.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls reconstruction error and contributes lambda*epsilonX to the coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the fifth iteration field, ug.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the local near-singularity condition, stability assumptions, and beta*ug term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the thirteenth iteration field, the n by k matrix VHat_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its stored spectrum is tested by D020.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-eighth iteration field, a spectrum certificate for VHat_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its sigmaMin and sigmaMax occur in the selected iteration's two spectral inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a semantics object from a predicate small, a predicate secondOrder, and a proof secondOrder(0).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It shows that no numerical or asymptotic laws constrain either predicate beyond inclusion of zero in secondOrder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the second semantics field, secondOrder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It classifies both the appendix's normalized vector remainder and the final scalar remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of the mgs certificate from D020 at k=1 and the law that failure of D020 at k+1 implies D080 at k for every 0 < k < n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the initial condition and transition implication used to construct a good endpoint or a good index immediately before the first failure. The implication conclusion D080 is assumed as a constructor field.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a spectrum certificate's second field, sigmaMax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For VHat_k it supplies the upper spectral quantity bounded by 4/3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a spectrum certificate's first field, sigmaMin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all minimum spectral values in the good condition, condition ratios, and right-preconditioner coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of an appendix from a rightQuantities function and a function which, for every k, turns D020, k=n or D080, D001, and a right inverse pair into a D071 error certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The aggregate theorem assumes this conditional certificate-producing implication; it does not derive the underlying expansion or component bounds from the iteration equations alone.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of q from a spectrum certificate for MR Z_k plus positivity of sigmaMin(MR Z_k), ||MLinv A Z_k||_F, ||MLinv A MRinv||_F, ||MRinv||_F||MR||_F, and ||MR Ainv ML||_F||MLinv A MRinv||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These preloaded positivity facts make every denominator in alpha, beta, and lambda nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: A basis-family bundle for a system, constructed by D074 from matrices Z_k, injectivity certificates, and nesting equations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the method's basis matrices at every dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a family from a system, a basis family, and an iteration function on valid indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It confirms that the system, basis, and all iterations are supplied data rather than existential conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The bundled n-dimensional linear system type, whose constructor is D076.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its fields enforce positive dimension, invertibility of A and ML, nonzero b, and A xExact=b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the system's second field, A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A defines the exact equation and the transformed matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the system's third field, Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the certified two-sided inverse of A and appears in MR Ainv ML.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the system's fourth field, ML.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the left preconditioner whose inverse is MLinv and appears in MR Ainv ML.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the system's fifth field, MLinv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the transformed right-hand side MLinv b and matrices MLinv A Z_k and MLinv A MRinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type R^n represented as functions Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the vector space used for exact and computed solutions, residual data, and all norm inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a finite real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all matrix norms in condition products, coefficient ratios, perturbation bounds, and the local near-singularity threshold.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evidence that the natural numeral 4 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is implementation evidence allowing 4 to be interpreted as a real numeral in the exact constant 4/3; it adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evidence that the natural numeral 3 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is implementation evidence allowing 3 to be interpreted as a real numeral in 4/3; it adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Square matrix-vector multiplication, (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines inverse relations, A xExact=b, and MLinv b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real expression alpha*epsilonC + beta*epsilonB + beta*ug + lambda*epsilonX.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact linear combination used by D023.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: Left multiplication of an n by k matrix B by an n by n matrix A, with entries sum_q A_iq B_qj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all transformed matrices and products such as MR Z_k, MLinv A Z_k, and MR Ainv ML.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient alpha = (kappaR/sigmaMin(MR Z_k))*(||MLinv A Z_k||_F/||MLinv A MRinv||_F), where kappaR=||MRinv||_F||MR||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies epsilonC in the final coefficient and the matrix-computation contribution in the appendix certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient beta = max(1,(||MLinv A Z_k||_F/||MLinv A MRinv||_F)/sigmaMin(MR Z_k))*kappaR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies epsilonB and ug in the final coefficient and bounds the right-hand-side and iterative contributions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient lambda = 1/kappaP, where kappaP=||MR Ainv ML||_F||MLinv A MRinv||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies epsilonX inside the final coefficient and the reconstruction contribution in the appendix certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2) of a finite real vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the forward error, least-squares residuals, vector perturbation bounds, unit vectors, and normalized remainders.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the tenth iteration field, computedB, an n-vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is constrained by computedB=MLinv b+deltaB and enters the perturbed least-squares problem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the seventh iteration field, computedC, an n by k matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It satisfies computedC=MLinv A Z_k+deltaC and enters spectral and least-squares assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-third iteration field, a spectrum certificate for computedC.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its sigmaMin appears in a small-predicate condition; no positivity is directly required.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the eleventh iteration field, deltaB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error in computedB and is bounded conditionally by epsilonB||MLinv b||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the eighth iteration field, deltaC.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error in computedC and is bounded conditionally by epsilonC||MLinv A Z_k||_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-sixth iteration field, deltaX.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reconstruction error in xHat=Z_k yHat+deltaX and is conditionally bounded by epsilonX||Z_k yHat||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-fourth iteration field, a spectrum certificate for the exact transformed basis matrix MLinv A Z_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its sigmaMin appears in the second small-predicate condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twentieth iteration field, leastSquaresDeltaB.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It perturbs computedB in the assumed least-squares minimization and columnwise backward-error condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-first iteration field, leastSquaresDeltaC.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It perturbs computedC in the assumed least-squares minimization and columnwise backward-error condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: The iteration constructor. It stores d_k with d_k>=1; epsilonC, epsilonB, ug, epsilonX; computed and error matrices/vectors with computedC=MLinv A Z_k+deltaC and computedB=MLinv b+deltaB; nested VHat matrices and an upper-Hessenberg relation [computedB,computedC]=VHatNext[beta e1,H]; least-squares perturbations and yHat; spectrum certificates; and xHat=Z_k yHat+deltaX.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All these equations and quantities are constructor data assumed with the family. In particular, d_k and the computed expansion are not derived by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the twenty-second iteration field, yHat in R^k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the assumed least-squares minimizer and is used to reconstruct xHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the first semantics field, small.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears only in three constructor assumptions for D001 and has no intrinsic numerical force.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real m by k matrices, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all rectangular dimensions for basis, transformed, Krylov-like, and Hessenberg matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: A spectrum certificate for a matrix A. D086 stores nonnegative sigmaMin and sigmaMax, lower and upper action bounds sigmaMin||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2 <= sigmaMax||x||_2, and, when the column dimension is positive, unit vectors attaining both values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Stored certificates supply every sigmaMin and sigmaMax. Their extremizing-vector existentials are constructor assumptions, not target conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: A right-preconditioned error-decomposition certificate for a family, k, MR, MRinv, and q, constructed by D087.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The appendix conditionally supplies this certificate; its stored expansion and four component bounds are combined to derive the target's aggregate error inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of q's first field, the spectrum certificate of MR Z_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its sigmaMin is used in alpha and beta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a basis family's first field, the matrix-valued function k -> Z_k in R^(n by k).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the exact basis at the selected dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a basis family from matrices Z_k, injectivity of Z_k for 0<k<=n, and consistency of the first k columns of Z_{k+1} with Z_k whenever k<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Full-column-rank and nesting properties are preloaded assumptions of the method family, not conclusions of the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: A theorem that every inhabited system of dimension n satisfies 0<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Consequently any family has positive n; the outer n=0 case has no family object and is vacuous.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a system from 0<n; square matrices A,Ainv,ML,MLinv; vectors b,xExact; two-sided inverse proofs for A and ML; b != 0; and A xExact=b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are bundled system assumptions. They imply xExact is nonzero and make its norm a nonzero denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column concatenation [b,C], the n by (k+1) matrix whose first column is b and whose remaining columns are C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the Arnoldi-like relation, columnwise perturbations, and local near-singularity matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extraction of column j from a matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the columnwise least-squares perturbation bounds in D024.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: The global least-squares property: y minimizes ||b-Ay||_2 over every vector z of the same dimension.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an assumed component of D001 for the perturbed computed least-squares problem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every real phi>0, there exists a unit vector x in R^(k+1) such that ||[phi MLinv b, MLinv A Z_k]x||_2 is strictly less than d_k(ug+epsilonC)||[phi MLinv b, MLinv A Z_k]||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This local near-singularity condition is supplied by the mgs transition law before the first spectral failure and is a disjunctive premise of the appendix certificate. Its existential unit vectors are inside an assumed constructor field.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ratio ||A||_F/sigmaMin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the two quantities passed to the arbitrary small predicate in D024; division remains total if sigmaMin is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: Rectangular matrix-vector multiplication, (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines basis reconstruction, spectral action bounds, least-squares residuals, and singular-direction conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: The transformed right-hand side bTilde=MLinv b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact reference for computedB, its perturbation bound, and the first column in D080.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a basis matrix Z, the exact transformed matrix MLinv(AZ).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At Z_k it is the exact reference C_k in perturbation bounds, coefficient ratios, spectra, and D080.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sum of squares sum_i x_i^2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root is the Euclidean norm D056.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a spectrum certificate from nonnegative sigmaMin and sigmaMax, universal lower and upper norm inequalities, and conditional unit-vector attainment of each value when the column dimension is positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All spectral facts are assumed certificate fields. For the selected k>0 the attainment implications have true antecedents.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef087
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of D071. It stores vectors c,r,g,s,R with xHat-xExact=c+r+g+s+R; secondOrder(||R||_2/||xExact||_2); and bounds ||c||/||xExact|| <= d_k kappaP alpha safeRatio(||deltaC||,||MLinv A Z_k||), ||r||/||xExact|| <= d_k kappaP beta safeRatio(||deltaB||,||MLinv b||), ||g||/||xExact|| <= d_k kappaP beta ug, and ||s||/||xExact|| <= kappaP lambda safeRatio(||deltaX||,||Z_k yHat||).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exact expansion, vector remainder, and component bounds are constructor assumptions supplied through the appendix. The target derives only their aggregate scalar bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef088
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a system's sixth field, the nonzero right-hand side b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines MLinv b and, with A xExact=b, ensures xExact is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef089
dependency_coverage.meaning: Injectivity of the linear map x -> Ax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is assumed for each basis matrix Z_k with 0<k<=n, expressing full column rank.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef090
dependency_coverage.meaning: The upper-Hessenberg condition H_ij=0 whenever j+1<i for a (k+1) by k matrix H.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is preloaded in each iteration's Arnoldi-like factorization but does not occur directly in the final formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef091
dependency_coverage.meaning: There exists a unit vector x with ||Ax||_2 strictly below the supplied threshold.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the existential content of D080 and can make D080 impossible when the threshold is nonpositive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef092
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of compatible rectangular matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states [computedB,computedC]=VHatNext[beta e1,H].

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef093
dependency_coverage.meaning: The vector beta e1 in R^(k+1): beta at index zero and zero elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the first column of the small matrix in the iteration's Arnoldi-like relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef094
dependency_coverage.meaning: The guarded ratio safeRatio(actual,reference), equal to 0 when reference=0 and actual/reference otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the preloaded component bounds, preventing literal division by zero there but potentially collapsing a relative quantity to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It joins the selected spectral condition to the conditional error statement and joins every pair of component conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies the selected k, the final scalar remainder, and several witnesses inside assumed certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At real arguments it is ordinary real multiplication in the final bound and coefficient formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: They index the ambient dimension, selected dimension, columns, and finite progression.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, error parameters, coefficients, and remainders are real.

binders: For every semantics object consisting of predicates small, secondOrder : R -> Prop and a proof secondOrder(0).
For every method family containing an n-dimensional system, a nested basis Z_j, and a preconstructed iteration I_j for every integer j with 1 <= j <= n.
Given an mgs certificate for that family, and for every appendix certificate for the same family.
The conclusion existentially selects one k with 1 <= k <= n. This k is selected before the stability antecedent and before MR and MRinv are quantified.
If the selected iteration has a D001 stability certificate, then for every pair MR,MRinv of real n by n matrices and every proof that they are two-sided inverses.
For each such pair, q is defined as appendix.rightQuantities(k,MR,MRinv,hMR), so q depends on the family, appendix, k, the matrices, and the inverse proof.
Inside the final bound there exists a real scalar remainder rho. It may depend on all preceding data, including the selected k, stability certificate, right inverse pair, and q.

Formally, because the existential k follows the appendix binder, k may depend on semantics, family, mgs, and appendix, but it cannot depend on MR, MRinv, hMR, q, or the later stability proof. The mgs fields alone provide the finite index-selection laws.
hypotheses: The bundled system has n>0; A,Ainv,ML,MLinv in R^(n by n); b,xExact in R^n; Ainv is a two-sided inverse of A; MLinv is a two-sided inverse of ML; b is nonzero; and A xExact=b.
The bundled basis supplies Z_j in R^(n by j), injective as a linear map for every 1<=j<=n, with Z_j equal to the first j columns of Z_(j+1) whenever j<n.

Each iteration I_k preloads d_k>=1; epsilonC_k, epsilonB_k, ug_k, epsilonX_k; exact C_k=MLinv A Z_k and bTilde=MLinv b; computedC_k=C_k+deltaC_k and computedB_k=bTilde+deltaB_k; VHat_k in R^(n by k), VHatNext in R^(n by (k+1)), an upper-Hessenberg H in R^((k+1) by k), and [computedB_k,computedC_k]=VHatNext[beta e1,H]; yHat in R^k; xHat=Z_k yHat+deltaX; least-squares perturbations; and spectrum certificates for VHat_k, computedC_k, and C_k.
The mgs certificate assumes Good(1), and for every 0<j<n assumes the implication not Good(j+1) -> NearSingular(j). It does not store a selected k.

The appendix assumes a function producing q for every valid k and every right inverse pair. It also assumes that Good(k), together with k=n or NearSingular(k), a D001 stability certificate, and a right inverse pair, implies a D071 error-decomposition certificate.

The conditional D001 antecedent bundles epsilonC, epsilonB, ug, epsilonX >=0; ||deltaC||_F<=epsilonC||C_k||_F; ||deltaB||_2<=epsilonB||bTilde||_2; global least-squares optimality of yHat for computedC+leastSquaresDeltaC and computedB+leastSquaresDeltaB; the stated columnwise d_k ug perturbation bound; small(ug||computedC||_F/sigmaMin(computedC)); small((epsilonC+epsilonB+ug)||C_k||_F/sigmaMin(C_k)); ||deltaX||_2<=epsilonX||Z_k yHat||_2; and small(epsilonX).
For each quantified MR,MRinv, hMR assumes both MRinv(MR x)=x and MR(MRinv x)=x for every x.
The q supplied by the appendix preloads a spectrum for MR Z_k and strict positivity of sigmaMin(MR Z_k), ||C_k||_F, ||MLinv A MRinv||_F, kappaR, and kappaP.

The D071 certificate supplied by the appendix preloads the exact vector expansion xHat-xExact=c+r+g+s+R, the fact secondOrder(||R||_2/||xExact||_2), and four separate component error bounds. These are assumed certificate fields rather than consequences proved by the target declaration.
conclusions: There exists one valid k with 1<=k<=n such that both 1/sigmaMin(VHat_k)<=4/3 and sigmaMax(VHat_k)<=4/3.
For that same k, if its D001 stability certificate is supplied, then the asserted forward-error relation holds for every certified right inverse pair MR,MRinv.

Writing kappaP=||MR Ainv ML||_F||MLinv A MRinv||_F and E_k=alpha*epsilonC+beta*epsilonB+beta*ug+lambda*epsilonX, there exists rho with secondOrder(rho) and ||xHat-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2 <= d_k E_k kappaP + |rho|.

The selected k is a genuine existential conclusion constructed from the finite mgs progression; it is not a field of mgs, the family, or the appendix. Internally the local laws permit choosing either k=n or a good k satisfying NearSingular(k), although that disjunction is not exposed in the target conclusion.

The scalar rho is also a genuine target existential. By contrast, spectral extremizers, NearSingular unit vectors, q, the vector error contributors, the vector remainder, the exact error expansion, and component bounds are already supplied through constructors or appendix fields.
mathematical_definitions: Vectors in R^m are functions Fin m -> R with ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2). Matrices in R^(m by k) are functions Fin m -> Fin k -> R with Frobenius norm ||A||_F.
A spectrum certificate for A in R^(m by k) stores nonnegative sigmaMin and sigmaMax satisfying sigmaMin||x||_2<=||Ax||_2<=sigmaMax||x||_2 for every x, and, if k>0, unit vectors attaining both bounds.
Good(k) means the conjunction 1/sigmaMin(VHat_k)<=4/3 and sigmaMax(VHat_k)<=4/3.
NearSingular(k) means: for every phi>0 there exists x in R^(k+1) with ||x||_2=1 and ||[phi bTilde,C_k]x||_2 < d_k(ug+epsilonC)||[phi bTilde,C_k]||_F.
C_k=MLinv A Z_k, bTilde=MLinv b, P=MLinv A MRinv, and Pinv=MR Ainv ML.
Let s=sigmaMin(MR Z_k) from q and t=||C_k||_F/||P||_F. Then alpha=(kappaR/s)t, beta=max(1,t/s)kappaR, and lambda=1/kappaP.
The exact computed coefficient is E_k=alpha epsilonC+beta epsilonB+beta ug+lambda epsilonX.
The right-hand side before the second-order remainder is exactly d_k E_k kappaP.
The relative forward error is err_k=||xHat-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2.
The final relation is existential, not big-O notation: there is a real rho satisfying the uninterpreted predicate secondOrder and err_k<=d_k E_k kappaP+|rho|.
safeRatio(a,b), used only in the appendix's component bounds, is 0 when b=0 and a/b otherwise.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every supplied numerical semantics and every method family satisfying the bundled system, basis, iteration, and mgs constructor data, and for every supplied appendix certificate, one can select a dimension k between 1 and n whose stored VHat spectrum satisfies 1/sigmaMin<=4/3 and sigmaMax<=4/3. The mgs object does not contain this k: it supplies Good(1) and a local failed-next implication, so a finite scan can choose n if all iterations remain good or the good iteration immediately preceding the first failure. For this same k, the following is conditional. If the iteration already has the full D001 stability certificate, then for every right preconditioner MR and certified inverse MRinv, using the appendix-supplied q, the relative forward error is at most d_k times the explicitly defined coefficient alpha epsilonC+beta epsilonB+beta ug+lambda epsilonX times ||MR Ainv ML||_F||MLinv A MRinv||_F, plus the absolute value of some real remainder accepted by the arbitrary secondOrder predicate. The appendix has already assumed a suitable vector error expansion and its component bounds; the declaration's substantive conclusions are the selected k and the resulting aggregate scalar inequality with its scalar remainder.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The predicate small is completely arbitrary and has no axioms. If it is always true, its three uses impose no numerical smallness. If it is empty or false at any required value, D001 may be uninhabited and the target's error-bound implication is then vacuous.

The predicate secondOrder is also arbitrary; only secondOrder(0) is required. If it contains only 0, the final result requires the exact inequality without slack. If it contains every real, an arbitrarily large |rho| can make the final conclusion essentially trivial.
No relationship is encoded between small and secondOrder, and neither predicate is given an asymptotic, perturbative, or limiting interpretation.

Real division is totalized at zero. In particular, a spectrum certificate permits sigmaMin(VHat_k)=0, and then 1/sigmaMin is 0 in Lean, so the first Good(k) inequality holds rather than excluding singular VHat_k. If sigmaMin>0, that inequality does imply sigmaMin>=3/4.

The sigmaMin values in the two small-predicate ratios are not explicitly required to be positive. A zero denominator therefore evaluates through totalized division and can collapse the purported condition ratio.

The coefficient denominators are protected by q: q requires sigmaMin(MR Z_k)>0, ||MLinv A MRinv||_F>0, and kappaP>0. The forward-error denominator is protected indirectly because b!=0, A xExact=b, and A is invertible imply xExact!=0.

The selected dimension cannot be zero because k is a subtype with 0<k<=n. An inhabited family also forces n>0. At n=0 the family type has no constructor, so the universal statement over families is vacuous.

For a family without an mgs certificate, there is no mgs binder value and hence no obligation. Likewise, if no appendix certificate can be constructed, the universal quantification over appendices is vacuous.

Constructing an appendix is strong: it must produce q for every valid k and every certified right inverse pair, including all of q's positivity proofs, and must produce D071 under its stated premises.
The final error assertion is behind the implication antecedent D001. The theorem makes no unconditional forward-error claim for an iteration lacking that certificate.

For any particular MR,MRinv without a proof hMR of two-sided invertibility, the dependent universal binder has no branch and imposes no conclusion. The matrices A and ML, and every considered MR pair, are otherwise nondegenerate through explicit inverse certificates.

The basis matrices Z_k are injective for valid k, while A and ML are invertible. Nevertheless computedC, VHat, and other stored matrices may be degenerate unless their separate certificates rule this out.
The dimension factor d_k is arbitrary preloaded real data with only d_k>=1. There is no formula identifying it with n, k, a square root, or any conventional dimension constant.

The spectrum objects are supplied certificates rather than values computed by an SVD routine. Their axioms characterize lower and upper attained action norms when the column dimension is positive, but the target does not compute them.

NearSingular(k) uses a strict inequality. If d_k(ug+epsilonC)||[phi bTilde,C_k]||_F is nonpositive, its unit-vector conclusion is impossible; this can make the corresponding mgs transition or appendix premise uninhabited.

The guarded ratio safeRatio(a,b) is defined as zero when b=0, regardless of a. In the D001 setting other nonnegativity and perturbation bounds may force the relevant numerator to zero, but the definition itself encodes no such implication.
The endpoint-or-NearSingular property used to invoke the appendix is not part of the visible target conclusion. Only Good(k) and the conditional aggregate bound are exposed.

The exact vector error expansion and four component inequalities are constructor assumptions of the appendix-provided D071 certificate. The mgs transition conclusion and the appendix's certificate-producing implication are also assumed fields. Only the aggregate final bound is derived from them.
No convergence rate, residual decrease, uniqueness of yHat, canonical choice of k, canonical right quantities, or unconditional existence of a stability certificate is encoded.
ambiguities: The mathematical meanings of small and secondOrder cannot be sharpened beyond arbitrary predicates with secondOrder(0); interpreting them as conventional first- or second-order asymptotics would add information absent from the dossier.
No formula or intended conventional value is given for dimensionFactor, so it can only be translated as an arbitrary real iteration field satisfying d_k>=1.

The packet defines spectrum certificates axiomatically through norm bounds and attainment rather than identifying them with a particular singular-value construction; the translation therefore uses exactly those axioms and does not assume additional spectral theory.
